description: Metadata for public White House OSTP pages about AI policy on www.whitehouse.gov. Each canonical URL was confirmed with one bounded GET that returned HTML. Rows store the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page bodies, executive-order text, and PDFs are not stored. Rights is us_government_work only when a rights field says the item is a US government work, and creative_commons only for CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA. Other Creative Commons deeds stay unknown. A public page, a .gov host, or a copyright year is not enough. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. A missing date is unknown. runner_wired is false.
